description: This module creates or deletes pools to be used on IBM Spectrum Accelerate Family storage systems.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Adds the pool to the specified domain.

parameters.name: endpoints
parameters.description: The hostname or management IP of Spectrum Accelerate storage system.

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Password for username on the Spectrum Accelerate storage system.

parameters.name: perf_class
parameters.description: Assigns a perf_class to the pool.

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: Management user on the Spectrum Accelerate storage system.

examples:
- name: Create new pool.
  community.general.ibm_sa_pool:
    name: pool_name
    size: 300
    state: present
    username: admin
    password: secret
    endpoints: hostdev-system

- name: Delete pool.
  community.general.ibm_sa_pool:
    name: pool_name
    state: absent
    username: admin
    password: secret
    endpoints: hostdev-system
